These support eastern bos/bu.so/bɔ̃s/bə̃s/bõs/bõːs and Jaunsari bo. Chilisso vāz is a provisional voiced-sibilant family match. Preserve the source vowels, nasalization and internal spacing and qualify local changes/cross-IA transmission. Exact response: bos.
